scope: Read-only review of frozen fake DART/IRQ models and original DART codec, pinned MIT facts, and saved ADT. New independent probes and logs are private/offline; no implementation or old receipt edits.

verdict.documented_host_only_single_context_cont: No blocking defect found within its documented caller serialization, valid-object and nonaliasing preconditions. Focused tests independently rerun successfully.

pinned_reference.permission_bit_provenance_limit: The unchanged codec records historical Linux numerical cross-checks for widths/permissions/RID semantics. This review reused that original codec and read its provenance; it did not read GPL driver sources or independently rederive NO_READ/NO_WRITE solely from the MIT Python map.

saved_ADT.method: Executed only AST-extracted original bounded parse_adt function with stdlib struct; no survey/transport imports. Full input consumed. Only selected MSI numbers emitted.
saved_ADT.inference_limit: ADT message address/vector metadata supports this fake profile, not live routing, allocation ownership, MSI delivery or SID3 ownership.

verified_behaviors.finding: Exact RID0x100 and SID<16 checked per object. Canonical32-bit IOVA/36-bit PA,16KiB pages,slot0,<=256 leaves in one32MiB span, aligned full pages. Exact APCIE aperture and MSI-page exclusion retained. Full validation rejects table/data PA overlap, duplicate leaves, orphan/reused tables, reservations and malformed encodings. Only explicit READ/WRITE bits admitted; software lookup checks requested access and revalidates image.

Initial link/RUN/PCI refusal precedes workspace writes. Mapping stages in caller RAM, validates, rechecks link, then copies two tables under caller serialization. Bound IO faults latch faulted and block later work. PA output changes only on successful codec lookup under the nonalias precondition; no DART registers or publication.

DART fixture retains PHY0x80 while synthetic link is independentlyUP; wrapper never reads PHY and makes only software mappings. IRQ requires PHY(mask0x8f)==0x0f before port reads and again after RUN/LINK/PCI. Neither is proof of real PMGR/RC reachability or atomic physical readiness; no integration may silently equate these states.

Exact metadata profile, allocated8-bit mask, mask-latched/coalesced pending bits, one-lowest-eligible-bit dispatch and arithmetic704+vector output. EMPTY/fault/refusal preserve source/output under nonalias precondition. Counter overflow refused. Close requires armed, ready, all allocated masked and pending empty, and prevents reopening.

verified_behaviors.area: Gated/default builds and missing hardware layout
verified_behaviors.finding: Fake flags require host accessor; KERNEL+fake and shared-write escape compile-refused. Default/host-KERNEL APIs return GATED without I/O or state changes. Both sources contain no register writer. IRQ state fields are RAM model fields; T602X/T6031 MSIMAP code is not generalized into a T8103 MSI layout.

concrete_integration_gaps.finding: No cross-object exclusive ownership registry. Two disjoint maps can bind the same RID/SID to different images, and two interrupt objects can allocate the same vectors. Checked callback identity is provenance plumbing, not a resource lease.
concrete_integration_gaps.evidence: Independent ASan probes reproduced both successful duplicate-object cases.
concrete_integration_gaps.required_contract: One composing owner must bind and reserve the endpoint, SID and vector set, reject duplicate lifetimes, and invalidate stale handles. Do not equate per-object bound/allocated flags with system ownership.

concrete_integration_gaps.finding: DART shallow-copies policy range pointers and borrows table/workspace buffers. Its CPU overlap checks cover root/leaf and workspace/table spans, not every map/accessor/policy/output alias. IRQ rejects exact input-subobject alias in open and vector==irq, but does not validate every output/state span.
concrete_integration_gaps.evidence: Headers explicitly require stable, serialized, nonaliasing objects; source does not enforce a general ownership/span proof.
concrete_integration_gaps.required_contract: Composing storage owner must keep all borrowed objects alive, disjoint and suitably immutable, including output variables. Never publish these structs as independently verified ownership tokens; stronger rejection requires a distinct future revision.

concrete_integration_gaps.finding: Bound DART read faults are sticky; IRQ read faults preserve state and are explicitly retryable. IRQ close cannot resolve link/PHY loss or pending events, and close of an opened-but-unarmed source returns STATE. DART has no unmap/close.
concrete_integration_gaps.evidence: Independent probe confirms IO retry, LINK_DOWN close with retained state, BUSY after link restoration while pending, and STATE for open/unarmed close.
concrete_integration_gaps.required_contract: Define owner cancellation and retained-failure states before composition. Do not fake successful close/drain, unmask merely to manufacture cleanup, clear pending events, or reuse exposed resources. No real interrupt/device quiescence is proved.

concrete_integration_gaps.finding: bfd_init validates endpoint/geometry metadata but defers complete RAM/reservation/image validation until map. A malformed RAM pointer/count policy can return initOK then mapping fails with zero table commit.
concrete_integration_gaps.evidence: Independent probe with ram=NULL,ram_count=1 returned initOK, mapDLD_ARGUMENT, mapped=false/table_commits0.
concrete_integration_gaps.required_contract: Treat bound as recorded model metadata only. Require successful validated mapping and retained owner lifetime for even a later fake transaction; no DMA or hardware admission follows.

concrete_integration_gaps.finding: No actual SID selection, IOKit mapper, wired allocation, cache/TLBI completion, TTBR publication, endpoint containment, MSI capability programming, AIC handler lifetime or T8103 MSI acknowledgement contract exists in these models.
concrete_integration_gaps.required_contract: Keep fake integration distinct from a real adapter. Existing shared PHY/PMGR/GPIO/SMC gates and GPU observer hold remain unchanged.

tests.probe_compile: clang C11 Wall Wextra Werror Wpedantic O1 g ASan UBSan fno-sanitize-recover=all; respective BFD_FAKE_DEVICE/BMI_FAKE_DEVICE plus APB_HOST_TEST_ACCESSOR; unchanged accessor/bringup/linkup/perst/radio and codec(DART) linked. Both exit0.
